name: FAUST
description: Full Annotation Using Shape-constrained Trees: data-driven discovery and annotation of cell phenotypes per sample (Greene et al. 2021). Version 1 is a Rust port of the R operator (FAUST 0.5.5 + scamp 0.5.0): the thresholds, the per-cell phenotype labels and the gates are identical to the single-thread R run on the same seed; the UMAP coordinates follow the same landmark layout but come from umaprs, so they differ from uwot's.

properties.name: selectionQuantile
properties.description: A marker is kept when this quantile of its depth score across samples is at least depthScoreThreshold (FAUST selectionQuantile).

properties.name: depthScoreThreshold
properties.description: Depth score a marker must reach, at selectionQuantile, to be used for annotation (FAUST depthScoreThreshold).

properties.name: seed
properties.description: Random seed (FAUST seedValue). The same seed gives the same thresholds, labels and gates as the R operator at threadNum = 1.

properties.name: sample_factor
properties.description: Column factor that names the sample (file, donor). Empty uses a projected factor called filename, as the R operator does, else all cells are one sample.

properties.name: threads
properties.description: Samples are processed in parallel; 0 uses every core the task is given. The result does not depend on the thread count.

metaFactors.name: Clusters
metaFactors.description: Represents the observations (e.g. cells), optionally with the sample they belong to (filename)

metaFactors.name: Measurement
metaFactors.description: Value of measurement signal of the channel/marker

outputSpecsV2.description: FAUST phenotype label, per-marker gates and UMAP coordinates per cell
